title: Custom LEV Bike Integration
desc:
-Identified and resolved factory manufacturing defects in the original frame, ensuring careful restoration of structural integrity.  

-Overcame strict spatial limitations within the main frame triangle by designing a custom top-mounted battery enclosure system.  

-Managed strict budgetary constraints by performing cross-compatible component sourcing, maintaining a lean design-to-production lifecycle (under $600 for 32mph top speed).  

-Validated drivetrain reliability and thermal management through ~200 miles of real-world operations, achieving full capital cost recovery within the first month.

title: 5-Inch FPV Drone
desc:
-Executed micro-scale precision soldering to integrate a high-density electronics stack, including a 4-in-1 Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) and Flight Controller (FC) on a compact carbon-fiber chassis.  

-Conducted rigorous electrical continuity testing and diagnostic troubleshooting to isolate signal noise, ensuring secure power distribution and data communication lines.  

-Logged extensive manual and simulated flight hours to master specialized aerodynamic handling, utilizing real-time analog/digital telemetry feedback to monitor system performance.

title: Potential Energy Propulsion Racer
desc:
-Co-designed and manufactured dual-propulsion vehicle (two-spring potential energy drivetrain and a 10F supercapacitor-driven propeller) under physical constraints (12"x8"x4").

-Iterated 4+ chassis geometries and custom mechanical components using SolidWorks; optimizing structure and material to achieve a light 20.62g ABS chassis.

-Developed a functional 2.5:1 ratio gear train.

-Conducted physical testing and performance verification over a 60-foot competitive track; cross-referenced hand-calculated kinematic models against experimental outcomes to secure a top-tier score.

title: Virtual Work Station
desc:
-Rigged dorm with cable harness and charging system for ease of access to virtual reality desktop studio alongside 'infinite' battery life

-Software stack (ALVR, Desktop+) custom downloaded for quality of life

-Styled for vibration dampening to reduce wear on desktop components

title: Personal Portfolio Web Application
desc:
-Custom-built interactive portfolio site utilizing React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for responsive design and fluid animations.

-Features a dynamic, theme-switchable UI with integrated content management capabilities for real-time project updates.

-Includes a specialized "Edit Mode" allowing for administrative control and local data persistence via JSON export/import workflows.

-Designed as a lightweight, static-deployable application to showcase engineering hardware projects and professional contact information efficiently.
